content:
I’m a PhD student in computer science and member of the Responsible Artificial Intelligence group at Umeå University. My research is in Explainable Artificial Intelligence where I focus not only on the technical aspects of explanation generation, but also on how social interactions shape the impact of those methods in practice.
Currently, I am working on building a modular, end-to-end explainability pipeline to aid in my research. For fun, I work on mini projects both in Python and, more recently, Go. You can check out my research output here and my hobby projects here .
